evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: The foundation is in place. Your job is to extend it building new data models and the agents, wiring autonomous pipelines, and delivering AI-powered systems that directly improve how marketing decisions are made.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD is framed around rapidly building and shipping new AI agents and automations with success measured by number of live agents in 6 months, and no testing/governance/compliance language appears anywhere, making this velocity-dominant.
evidence.domain_risk: We are a leading trading platform that is ambitiously expanding to the four corners of the globe.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Capital.com is a fintech/trading platform (default-high sector) but this specific role is scoped to marketing analytics/AI agents with no financial-reporting or regulatory language, placing it at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: The foundation is in place. Your job is to extend it
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing marketing data infrastructure foundation is explicitly stated as already in place, with the role extending and scaling it rather than starting from zero or joining a fully mature specialized team.
evidence.jd_authorship: AI agent development design, build, and improve specialist AI agents covering channel performance, budget allocation, media monitoring, user quality, and competitive intelligence
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise, specific systems and use cases (attribution models, AI agents by domain, Slack bot tooling) that describe exactly what the person builds.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: delivering AI-powered systems that directly improve how marketing decisions are made... natural language access to AI analysis for the wider marketing team
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: All responsibilities and success metrics are explicitly scoped to serving the marketing team and marketing decision-making, a commercial orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: take ownership of the next phase of this infrastructure... Your job is to extend it
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role explicitly takes ownership of the next phase of infrastructure and is measured by outcomes like reduced manual work, indicating strategic direction-setting rather than scoped execution.
evidence.ai_role: AI agent development design, build, and improve specialist AI agents... Experience with LLMs (prompt engineering, agent design) and workflow automations (n8n or similar tool)
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to build AI agents, LLM-based automations, and AI-powered systems as the core deliverable of the role, making the candidate a builder of AI-consuming/AI-powered infrastructure.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: No testing, data contracts, or data quality practice is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely around building new capability and measurable adoption/efficiency outcomes with no risk, compliance, or reliability register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: building new data models and the agents, wiring autonomous pipelines, and delivering AI-powered systems
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The explicit task is building new agents, automations, and pipelines that extend an existing foundation, dominated by greenfield-building verbs.
